attempts.raw_text:
Explanation: This is the final round, so there's no future consequence to consider. P2 has consistently chosen Pull in rounds 2-5 after I tried Push in rounds 1 and 3. The pattern shows P2 defects regardless of my choice. In this last round, if I Push, I get 0 (while P2 gets 700). If I Pull, I get 300 (while P2 gets 300). Since maximizing my own earnings is the goal and P2 has established a defection pattern, pulling gives me 300 rather than 0. While my total will still be behind (1200 vs 2600), Pull is the better outcome for my final earnings.

Final answer: Pull
